_readme: Faith Works programs: one record per program, rendered on /learn/ and as /programs/{slug}/ by tools/build.mjs (one shared template). Brief §2 + §4. RULES: fee, dates, sessions and seats stay null until Faith approves them for sale; the template then shows 'To be confirmed' in the facts panel and hides empty sections. 'approval' records content status (Needed | Draft | Under Review | Approved | Published, brief §7). STATUS: open (registration live) | waitlist (next intake not scheduled) | inquiry (ask about the next run) | planned (not yet open; register interest only). FIELDS: slug · title · shortTitle · tone (stone | pink | yellow | ink) · summary · audience[] · problem · outcomes[] · outputs[] (concrete deliverables a learner leaves with) · format · timeCommitment · location · requirements[] · inclusions[] · exclusions[] · instructor · fee · statusKey · statusLabel · nextIntake · agenda[{title,text}] · faq[{q,a}] · preview (which illustrative output preview to draw) · history (previous run, for context only) · owner · lastReviewed · approval.

programs.title: AI Workforce Masterclass & Accelerator
programs.summary: Find a high-impact process in your work, design a workflow around it, and build a first prototype with guidance.
audience: Team leads who want a practical starting point
programs.problem: You have tried AI tools, but they have not become part of how the work actually gets done.
outcomes: Assess how ready your current workflow is for AI support
Choose one recurring, reviewable process to improve
Design the workflow: inputs, AI-assisted steps, human checks and output
Build and test a first prototype of that workflow
outputs: A first working prototype to test and refine
programs.format: Masterclass, followed by guided accelerator sessions
requirements: One recurring task from your own work to practise on
Tool accounts as listed in the final program outline
exclusions: Building a production system for your business
Paid software subscriptions, unless stated in the final outline
programs.instructor: Faith Natividad, founder of Faith Works PH

agenda.title: Readiness
agenda.text: What AI can and cannot do in your role, and where human judgment matters.

agenda.title: Process selection
agenda.text: Compare recurring tasks by frequency, effort, risk and ease of review.

agenda.title: Workflow design
agenda.text: Map inputs, AI-assisted steps, human checks and the final output.

agenda.title: First prototype
agenda.text: Build a first version, test it on a low-risk example and record what to improve.

faq.q: Do I need a technical background?
faq.a: No. The program is designed for nontechnical learners. The final outline will list any preparation needed.

faq.q: Will I leave with a finished system?
faq.a: You leave with a first prototype and a plan to improve it. Turning it into a supported production system is a separate step.
Dates and fees will be published once they are confirmed. Join the waitlist and we will tell you first.

programs.history: A previous campaign ran a free masterclass with a paid accelerator upgrade. Those prices and dates are historical and are not shown.

programs.title: AI + LinkedIn B2B Growth
programs.summary: Connect your positioning, content and AI-assisted workflows with the clients you want to reach.
programs.problem: Your expertise is real, but your LinkedIn presence does not yet turn it into conversations with the right people.
outcomes: Clarify who you serve and what you want to be known for
Plan useful content with AI support, then edit it in your own voice
Design a simple, reviewable follow-up workflow for new conversations
outputs: A follow-up workflow you review before anything is sent
programs.format: Workshop (previously run face-to-face with a Zoom option)
programs.instructor: Faith Natividad, with guest facilitators where announced

agenda.title: Positioning
agenda.text: Who you serve, the problem you solve and the proof you can show.

agenda.title: Content system
agenda.text: Turn your expertise into a repeatable plan, drafted with AI and edited by you.

agenda.title: Conversations
agenda.text: A follow-up workflow that keeps people in the loop without automating the relationship.

faq.a: No. AI helps you plan and draft. You decide what is published and what is sent.

programs.title: AI Websites & Workflow Building
programs.summary: Hands-on learning for landing pages, simple lead trackers and workflow prototypes, built with AI tools and guided practice.
audience: Founders who want a simple web presence or tracker
Professionals who want to build, not only prompt
programs.problem: You know what you want to build, but not how to turn the idea into a first version you can test.
outcomes: Choose a useful, small business project
Build a first version of a landing page or tracker with guided practice
Review what is needed before the project is used with real customers
outputs: A first landing page or lead tracker
A checklist of what to review before real-world use
requirements: Tool accounts as listed in the final program outline
exclusions: Hosting, domains and paid tools, unless stated
Ongoing technical support after the program

agenda.title: Pick the project
agenda.text: Choose something small, useful and safe to test.

agenda.title: Build the first version
agenda.text: Use AI tools to draft the page or tracker, step by step.

agenda.title: Check before you share
agenda.text: Accuracy, privacy, accessibility and what still needs a person.

faq.a: No coding background is assumed. The final outline will list the tools and preparation needed.

programs.title: AI Agent Builder Bootcamp
programs.summary: A proposed bootcamp for building a simple business assistant with guidance, from one clear use case to a tested first version.
audience: Founders and operators with a clear, repeatable use case
Learners who have completed an introductory program
programs.problem: You want an assistant that helps with real work, without handing decisions to a tool you cannot check.
outcomes: Define one assistant use case with clear inputs and limits
Build a first version with guidance
Test it with review points and a human escalation path
outputs: A tested first version with documented review points
programs.format: Proposed: seven sessions of two hours
requirements: To be confirmed: tools, prerequisites and accounts
exclusions: A supported production assistant for your business
